definitions.gloss: new life, fresh start, new lifestyle
definitions.explanation: A new phase or chapter of life, typically associated with moving, starting a new job, entering school, or getting married. Especially prominent in Japan's April season of new beginnings.

examples.japanese: {四月|しがつ}から{新生活|しんせいかつ}が{始|はじ}まる。
examples.english: My new life begins in April.

examples.japanese: {新生活|しんせいかつ}に{必要|ひつよう}なものをそろえた。
examples.english: I prepared the things needed for my new life.

examples.japanese: {新生活|しんせいかつ}への{期待|きたい}と{不安|ふあん}が{入|い}り{混|ま}じっている。
examples.english: Excitement and anxiety about the new life are mixed together.

notes:
CULTURE:
In Japan, April marks the start of the fiscal and academic year. {新生活|しんせいかつ} is closely associated with this season, when many people move, start new jobs, or enter school. Stores run {新生活|しんせいかつ}セール (new life sales) promoting furniture, appliances, and household goods.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {新生活|しんせいかつ}を{始|はじ}める: to start a new life
- {新生活|しんせいかつ}の{準備|じゅんび}: preparations for a new life
- {新生活|しんせいかつ}セール: new-life sale
- {新生活|しんせいかつ}{応援|おうえん}: new-life support (marketing term)
